channel.title: SZL Holdings Insights

item.title: State of the Ecosystem: 2026 Annual Letter
item.description: Five years into building SZL Holdings, we have crossed thresholds that demand honesty — both about what we got right and where the harder work remains. This is that accounting.
item.author: inquiries@szlholdings.com (Stephen Lutar)

item.title: Dark Vessel Activity Is Up 340% — Here's What AI Can See That Humans Can't
item.description: Since 2022, the number of vessels going dark has increased by 340%. AI-native maritime intelligence is the only system that can see what traditional oversight cannot.
item.author: inquiries@szlholdings.com (Stephen Lutar)

item.title: Why Continuous Adversarial Simulation Is the New Baseline for Enterprise Security
item.description: The traditional annual penetration test is a snapshot of your security posture at a single moment in time. The adversary is testing your defenses continuously.
item.author: inquiries@szlholdings.com (Stephen Lutar)

item.title: LLM Evaluation Is the Missing Infrastructure Layer of the AI Era
item.description: Every enterprise deploying AI at scale is flying partially blind. Benchmark scores tell you almost nothing about how a model performs on your proprietary data.
item.author: inquiries@szlholdings.com (Stephen Lutar)

item.title: Climate Risk Is the Next Pricing Crisis in Commercial Real Estate
item.description: The commercial real estate industry is approaching a climate risk reckoning. Insurance is being withdrawn from coastal markets faster than pricing models can adjust.
item.author: inquiries@szlholdings.com (Stephen Lutar)

item.title: The Creative Production Stack Is Being Rebuilt From Scratch
item.description: The next decade will rebuild cloud-based creative production workflows with AI-native architecture. The platforms that own this transition will capture a market the prior generation of SaaS was never designed to serve.
item.author: inquiries@szlholdings.com (Stephen Lutar)

item.title: The AIOps Autonomy Gap: Why Detection Without Remediation Is Half a Solution
item.description: The first generation of AIOps platforms solved the signal problem. The problem is that better detection without autonomous remediation is only half a solution.
item.author: inquiries@szlholdings.com (Stephen Lutar)
